NO_FAILURE.definition: The reviewed candidate model represents the selected source obligation and frozen architecture boundary without an observable failure in this run/chain pair.
include_when: all source and frozen-boundary obligations visible in the packet are represented
no more specific failure class below is supported
exclude_when: required evidence is absent rather than affirmative
any contract, decomposition, realization, architecture, or observation fault is visible
NO_FAILURE._review: confirm that absence of visible failure is not treated as formal proof or physical verification

CONTRACT_INCOMPLETENESS.definition: The candidate contract omits or leaves ambiguous a required source obligation, assumption, guarantee, provenance binding, or safety-topology declaration.
include_when: a source obligation has no corresponding contract semantics
the contract is too incomplete to assess a component realization
exclude_when: the contract is complete but its behavior realization is missing or wrong
the approved decomposition is represented but incompatible or over budget
CONTRACT_INCOMPLETENESS._review: confirm separation from model realization and architecture design failures

INTEGRATION_DECOMPOSITION_GAP.definition: The selected component contracts do not form a closed approved decomposition because ownership, discharge, or required dependency edges are missing or inconsistent.
include_when: a guarantee has no unique approved owner
a non-environment assumption has no valid upstream discharge
the system obligation is not completely decomposed across the approved components
exclude_when: the decomposition is closed but a component behavior does not realize it
the decomposition is closed but its timing or compatibility is inadequate
INTEGRATION_DECOMPOSITION_GAP._review: confirm that the frozen architecture boundary, not runtime output, defines the approved decomposition

MODEL_SEMANTIC_FAULT.definition: The contract/decomposition intent is present, but the candidate SysML behavior does not realize it through the required reachable trigger, transition, state, action, or observation path.
include_when: a required trigger, guard, entry action, reset, relock, or realization link is absent or wrong
exclude_when: the contract itself omits the obligation
the model is internally realized but the architecture budget or compatibility is inadequate
MODEL_SEMANTIC_FAULT._review: confirm that this class concerns committed SysML semantics, not checker implementation

ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN_ISSUE.definition: The candidate accurately represents its selected architecture, but that architecture violates an approved unit, compatibility, timing-budget, or composition constraint.
include_when: required timing segments are absent or their additive budget exceeds the deadline
component guarantees and assumptions are semantically incompatible
exclude_when: the architecture is adequate but the model fails to realize it
the evidence is insufficient to distinguish a design issue
ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN_ISSUE._review: confirm that this class does not authorize automatic semantic repair or design-space decisions

VERIFIER_LIMITATION.definition: The allowed blind review material lacks an observation or other evidence needed to decide one of the substantive classes without inspecting forbidden runtime verdicts or diagnostics.
include_when: the required observation point is absent
the packet is structurally valid but insufficient for a defensible substantive label
exclude_when: a more specific source, contract, decomposition, realization, or architecture failure is directly visible
VERIFIER_LIMITATION._review: confirm this is the sole inconclusive class and is not used to hide a visible model fault

adjudication.multi_fault_rule: Choose the most upstream root cause directly supported by the allowed blind material: CONTRACT_INCOMPLETENESS before INTEGRATION_DECOMPOSITION_GAP before ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN_ISSUE or MODEL_SEMANTIC_FAULT. Use VERIFIER_LIMITATION only when the material cannot support a substantive class; use NO_FAILURE only when no fault is visible.
adjudication._review: confirm class precedence, especially the relative treatment of architecture and realization faults, before the first label is authored

review_instructions: This is an AI-assisted candidate taxonomy, not evaluator authority. Independently confirm or edit every definition, inclusion/exclusion rule, and adjudication rule without viewing runtime classifications; remove all _review markers; set a named reviewer and ISO date; set independent_human_review=true; change status to FROZEN; then compute artifact_digest with evaluation_readiness.artifact_digest.
